primary_source.authors: Jess Banks; Jorge Garza Vargas; Archit Kulkarni; Nikhil Srivastava
primary_source.title: Overlaps, Eigenvalue Gaps, and Pseudospectrum under real Ginibre and Absolutely Continuous Perturbations

summary: Primary-source audit shows Corollary 2.4 already has content for k=1 and j>=2, hence prior-covers the pure two-independent-bank scalar bilinear/affine rank-two subcase with the correct (sigma1 sigma2)^(-1/2) scale. Do not claim literature novelty for that subcase. This does not subsume the fleet's stronger QFORM-RANK2-BILINEAR-DIRECT-v1 when it permits arbitrary measurable H(U), and it does not cover the new B18 random-centre private-square theorem.
